text:
It was finally the big baseball game on Saturday. I was so excited because I was the captain. We were playing against the Tigers and it was raining a little bit. The rain was steady but we kept playing anyway. I grabbed my bat and walked up to the plate.

"You can do it, Timmy!" my mom yelled.

The pitcher was approaching the mound and he looked scary. He threw the ball fast. I started swinging as hard as I could. crack! I hit the ball and ran fast. Everyone was cheering for me. I saw my dog Sparky near the fence. He looked like a funny creature because he chewed on a newspaper. I ran all the way home and we won! My team greeted me with high fives.

"That was a home run!" shouted my coach.

We were winning and nobody could beat us any longer.

One day my friend Tim and I found a map. It had a big red stain on the corner. We realized it was a treasure map from a sailor. We ran to the old tree house. It was at a very big height. We climbed up the ladder fast.

"Look at this weird writing," Tim said.

"It looks foreign," I said back to him.

We saw a picture of a chest near the creek. We ran there but the box was closed tight. We tried to open it for no reason. Then Tim pulled a key from his pocket. He meant to show me it earlier. We opened it and found old coins inside! We took them home for cleaning. It was the best adventure ever.

I was walking to school and the wind blew hard. My backpack felt heavy and pulled me back. I almost fell but I used all my strength.

At recess we played kickball on the blacktop. Tommy kicked the ball so high it almost disappeared. It came down fast and landed near the fence.

"I got it!" yelled Sarah. She ran super fast.

But then she froze because a big bug was there. I ran over and looked at the bug on the earth.

"It looks like an alien," I said.

Then the bell rang and we all crashed into line. In art class, I drew a picture of the alien bug. My team won the art contest for best drawing. It was the best day ever.

My best friend Sarah was having a sleepover at her house. We played dress-up and Sarah was wearing a big shiny jewel. She looked like a queen in a giant castle. We pretended we were floating on clouds. Then her dad called us for dinner. He made stewed tomatoes and cheese toast. It smelled weird like foreign food but it tasted good.

"I believed you when you said you had pneumonia!" I said.

Sarah laughed and said, "I was just pretending to be sick!"

After we cleared the table, Sarah's mom started coaching us on dancing. We danced until we were tired enough to sleep. Then her little brother followed us into the room. He wanted to sleep there too but Sarah said no way.

I was playing my new video game against my sister. She is the best player in the whole surrounding area. My mom was bringing us snacks and watching the screen. Suddenly my sister moved her character really fast through the level. It happened so quickly I almost dropped my controller.

"You can't beat me today!" she yelled loudly.

"Just watch me win this race!" I shouted back.

My heart was beating like a drum in my vein. I jumped from a big height and landed perfectly. Then the phone started ringing, and my sister looked away. I zoomed past her and crossed the finish line first!

"My daughter is the winner!" Mom cheered for me.

I finally beat her at her favorite game.

It was a hot Wednesday and my brother Tim was bored. We searched the backyard for a big adventure. I saw a huge hole near the fence. It looked dangerous but that was the reason to go in. I grabbed my toy guitar for protection. Tim grumbled because he was scared of spiders.

We climbed down gradually into the dark tunnel. Suddenly, something fuzzy touched my leg! I screamed very loud and jumped back. Tim laughed at me.

"It is just a bungee cord!" he said.

"That was not a failure of my bravery," I told him.

We walked fourteen steps and found a shiny box. It was full of gold coins! But actually, it was just rocks and my imagination. We used a stick to measure the hole. It was deep! We climbed out fast for lunch.

We were playing the greatest game of hide-and-seek ever. My brother Tom was counting by the big oak tree. I ran to the woods and found a small trail. I crawled under a bush and waited for a long time. Suddenly, I heard footsteps crunching on the leaves nearby.

"I know you are here somewhere!" Tom shouted loudly.

I held my breath and tried to stay very still. The weight of my backpack felt heavy on my shoulders. I was scared he would see my bright red shoes. Then Tom walked past me and started to search again. I waited until he was gone and ran back.

"I made it to base first!" I yelled happily.

Tom walked back and he looked really crushed. He grumbled about my height being too small to see. Everyone cheered for me because I finally won the game.

My friend Sam and I loved to explore the big meadow. One day, we heard a weird noise sounding like a whistle. We walked through the tall grass and saw a big hole.

"Look at that!" shouted Sam. "It goes way down deep."

I looked down and saw a shiny blue feather. It meant a magic bird was trapped there.

"We have to save it," I said bravely.

We trained for climbing trees, so we started climbing down. The ground was slippery and I almost fell. I grasped a root quickly. It was real danger! We struggled but we got to the bottom. The bird was stuck in some vines. We cut the vines and it flew away happy. We climbed back up and felt like heroes. We often go back but stay safe now.

On Wednesday, I went exploring in my backyard woods. I cleared some sticks away and found a big hole. Suddenly a bunny came jumping out! It escaped into the bushes very fast. I looked closer and discovered a nest with babies. They were sleeping and looked like tiny fluff balls.

My mom yelled, "Come inside for lunch right now!"

I said, "But I found baby bunnies, Mom!"

She didn't hear me so I ran inside. We had chicken for lunch because my mom says I need protein. I kept the receipt from the pet store in my pocket. I was yearning for a pet bunny to keep me company. Later, a blue bird flew by the window. I understood that wild animals belong outside, but keeping a secret bunny would be fun.

My birthday party was going to be awesome. The weather was freezing outside but it was warm inside. My friends came over for a big sleepover. We played games and ate pizza and cake. Then we wanted to do a science experiment.

"Lets make slime in the kitchen!" said my friend Sam.

We pulled out the glue and the glitter. My mom helped us mix it all together. Suddenly the lights disappeared and it got dark. We were trembling a little bit because it was scary.

"Don't worry, I have a flashlight," my dad said.

He shined the light through the dark room. It looked like heaven with all the glitter shining. We discovered that slime glows in the dark too. We stayed up until fourteen minutes past midnight! It was the best birthday ever.

I was camping near a big mountain with my robot dog named Sparky. Sparky started singing a weird beeping song and his eyes turned red. Suddenly a green alien flew down from the sky. It escaped from a spaceship and it looked very scared.

"Help me find my magic jewel!" the alien screamed loudly.

Sparky sprinted into the dark woods and I ran after him. We found a cave and I had to squeeze inside. I saw something glowing bright blue. It was the jewel! I grabbed it but a giant spider struck at me. I caught the spider in my net just in time.

"You are brave enough to be a space ranger," the alien said.

My ears were ringing from the alien ship but I was happy. We ate marshmallows and looked at the stars.

I was wearing my new sneakers for gym class today. Everyone was trembling because we had to climb the big rope. I saw Timmy bumping into the mat and he looked scared. "You can do it!" I shouted.

Instead of climbing, Timmy crawled under the mat like he was camping. It was funny but Mr. Jones did not laugh. Then it was my turn. My finger felt like a needle poked it, but I kept going. I pulled myself through the air and touched the ceiling. The whole class started cheering for me.

"Good job!" said Mr. Jones when I came down.

We are leaving for lunch now, and I am building a huge sandwich. I hope we learn about dinosaurs next.

My brother Max had a birthday party on Saturday. We played tag in the backyard and it was fun. Dad was the guard of the bouncy castle. He stood straight and tall at the door.

Suddenly, Max twisted his ankle on a rock.

"Ouch, my foot hurts!" Max yelled loudly.

Mom pulled him up and looked at his leg. She saw a blue vein popping out.

"We need ice right now," Mom said.

Unfortunately, the party stopped for a little bit. Max sat down and crushed a juice box. He was sad because he disappeared from the game. But then my friend Sam started bumping into me. We all laughed. The day was a complete mess but still happy. Max felt better because of the cake.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We chose the path that went straight to the old cave. My dad taught us how to use a map. We were waiting for a big adventure.

"Look at that scorched tree!" Sam yelled loudly.

We scrambled over the big rocks to see it better. Unfortunately, a mean dog was sitting there. It looked like it wanted to reign over the forest. We didn't understand why it was alone. We ran through the bushes fast.

"I need some caffeine to stay awake!" I joked.

My dad was our guide, and he saved us. Not a single person got hurt that day. We didn't bungee jump, but it was still scary. Next time, we will bring treats for the dog.

I was swinging on the monkey bars at recess. The sun was hot and my hands were sweaty. I jumped down and ran to my backpack for a snack. I reached inside and my finger touched something sticky.

"Gross!" I yelled. My friend Tim ran over to look.

"What is that?" Tim asked me.

I pulled out a smashed banana. It was all chewed up and gooey. I discovered a big hole in the bottom of the bag. Crumbs were scattered everywhere inside my backpack. I was growing mad because my homework was sticky too.

"My mom is gonna be so mad," I said sadly.

I threw the gross banana in the trash can. Then the bell rang and Mrs. Jenkins greeted us at the door. I hope she likes sticky math sheets.

I was playing the most important basketball game ever. My heart was pumping super fast and I was sweaty. We were losing by two points and the clock moved slowly.

"Pass the ball to me!" shouted my friend Leo.

I looked at the hoop and I saw the net hanging there. I took a big breath and I threw the ball high. Everyone watched to measure if it would go in. It hit the rim and bounced around. Then something amazing happened. It fell right through the net!

"We won the game!" I yelled really loud.

After the game, I was so hungry for pizza. But first we had to help with cleaning the court. It was hard work but winning felt great.

Sam and I were roaming throughout the spooky woods. We were looking for the lost golden cup. My dad was coaching us on how to be brave.

"Keep walking and don't be scared!" shouted Sam.

We heard a loud noise behind a big rock. My heart was pumping very fast in my chest. We saw a big bear waiting for us there. It roared but we didn't run away. Sam threw a stick and the bear left.

"We did it!" I said. "We are safe now."

We found the cup under a tree. It was shiny and gold. We felt like a champion team that day. We knew failure was not an option for us. We ran home to show my dad our prize.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the old cave. We love science and wanted to find cool rocks. Sam was steering his bike fast and I followed him. We left our bikes by a big tree.

Inside it was dark and I felt scared. Suddenly we heard a weird moaning sound.

"Did you hear that?" Sam whispered.

"Yes, maybe it's a ghost," I said.

I froze but Sam was brave like a champion. We saw a big bear sleeping near a rock! The weight of my backpack felt heavy. We ran away fast. Later we roasted marshmallows and felt safe. Our mission was complete.

My family went on a big boating trip last summer. We woke up early and had eggs for breakfast. My dad was our guide, but he got lost.

"Which way do we go now?" I asked him.

"I think we turned the wrong way," Dad said.

We were floating down the river for a long time. Suddenly, our boat crashed into a big muddy bank! My mom dropped the scissors she was using to cut an apple. They fell into the water and sank fast. We were not leaving anytime soon.

Then we discovered a guard dog near a small house. He barked loud, but he was nice. The people inside gave us stewed carrots. The wind blew hard, so we stayed there all night. I didn't want to seize the day either. I just wanted to go home and sleep in my bed.

The red robot was roaming in the hot jungle. His name was Beep and he had a big brain. He was following a map to a magic fountain. Suddenly, a giant alien jumped out! It was bumping into trees and stamping its feet. The alien threw a rock and scorched the ground near Beep.

"Go away robot!" the alien yelled loudly.

"I need the magic water for my adventure," said Beep.

Beep scrambled up a tree and his arms grew longer. He toasted the alien with his laser eyes. The alien ran away fast. Beep found the fountain and drank the water. He felt strong and steady again.

One day my dog Buster got loose in the yard. He was running super fast toward the woods. I grabbed his blue leash and chased him.

"Come back, Buster!" I yelled very loud.

He did not listen and he crashed into some bushes. I reached inside to get him but then I yelled "Ouch!" Something was stinging my arm really bad. It was a big bee. Buster barked and ran away again.

My dad came outside wearing his pajamas. He looked tired because he did not have his caffeine yet.

"Neither of you are listening today," he grumbled.

We had to search for Buster for a long time. Finally we found him near the creek. He was wet and muddy but happy. We walked home and I put a band-aid on my sting. It was a crazy morning.

We went to the big meadow behind my house. My dog Spot ran ahead and started stamping his feet. He found a secret door in the dirt! I knew we had to go inside.

We climbed down thirteen steps and saw a dark tunnel. Something was bumping into the walls.

"What was that noise?" I asked Spot.

Spot just barked and ran deeper into the dark. We walked until we saw a giant castle made of mud. A rat sat there trying to gnaw on a bone.

"Do not enter!" the rat spoke in a mean voice.

Then Spot let out a giant sneeze. The rat got scared and swam away in a puddle. We found a pot of stewed carrots inside. I remembered that carrots are Spot's favorite snack. That is the reason we ate them all up. It was the best adventure that ever happened.

I was walking my dog named Colonel in the woods. Colonel is brown and he loves climbing over big logs. Suddenly he saw a squirrel and ran very fast. He disappeared behind a huge green bush. I heard him sounding like he was in trouble.

"Colonel! Come back right now!" I yelled with anger.

I ran to the bush and saw him stuck. His leash was caught on a sharp branch. He was trembling because he was scared. I struggled to pull the branch away. It was hard work. I finally got him free and I felt pleasure.

"You are a bad dog," I said, but I hugged him.

I thought he learned his lesson, but he didn't. For some reason he just wanted to chase squirrels again. I felt like swearing but I am not allowed. We went home safe.

My friends and I went deep into the scary jungle. There were big green trees and it was hot. Suddenly, a giant monkey jumped down from the ceiling of leaves! It was huge and had eight eyes.

"Run away fast!" screamed my friend Timmy.

We started running very fast but I tripped on a root. The monkey grabbed my shoe but I pulled it back. It was almost impossible to escape. Then a tiny gnat flew right into the monkey's eye. The monkey let go and rubbed its eye. We ran back home to complete our adventure safely. We ate ice cream and were happy.

I was playing soccer against the red team and my heart was pumping fast. We were tied fourteen to fourteen which is a huge score. Suddenly the ball disappeared into the bushes but I found it near a fountain. I ran back and saw a big kid looking like a tough sailor. My legs were trembling a little bit but I didn't stop.

"Pass it here!" yelled my friend Sam.

I kicked the ball hard and it touched the goalie’s fingers. It went in and we won the game! The other team was groaning and we cheered.

"We crushed them!" Sam shouted happily.

I was so thirsty so I drank water and it cleared my throat. Then I felt a sneeze coming. I sneezed so loud I got a stain on my shirt. My dad drove us home and I gradually fell asleep in the car. It was better than camping.

It was freezing outside so we had indoor recess. I wanted to play on the computer, but Tommy got there first. I was mad and twisted my face up. Then I saw a shiny thing under the teacher’s desk. It looked like a red jewel.

"Look what I discovered!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

Sam ran over and we tried to squeeze under the desk. It wasn't a jewel at all. It was just a piece of red plastic from some scissors.

"That's boring," Sam said. "I thought it was treasure."

Just then, Mrs. Miller appeared. She was stamping papers at her desk. She told us to go sit down because recess was over. It was time for lunch, and the cafeteria smelled like stewed tomatoes. I hope I get a gold star for earning good grades today.

It was the weirdest day at school ever. I had a really bad feeling about math class. I didn't do my homework so I felt like a failure. Mrs. Miller was writing foreign words on the big board. Suddenly my nose started to tickle really bad. I tried to stop it but I let out a huge sneeze!

"Bless you, Jimmy!" shouted my friend Sam from the back.

Then something crazy happened. My pencil started floating in the air. It looked like a magic trick I trained for. I almost fainted because it was so scary. The whole class was staring at my flying yellow pencil. It felt like a video game that was loading too slow. Then the bell rang and we all ran to recess.

I was waiting by the big oak tree for my dog. His name is Buster and he is the best captain ever. We pretend the backyard is a foreign land.

"Come here, Buster!" I yelled loudly.

He ran over and licked my thumb. It was gross but funny. We walked together into the tall grass. The dirt felt grounding on my bare feet.

"Look at that bug," I said to Buster.

He sniffed it and wagged his tail fast. We counted five red ladybugs on one leaf. It was a wonderful day to be an explorer. Then my mom called us for lunch, so we ran back home. We were hungry explorers.

I was playing my new video game about camping. My character had to climb a big green mountain. It was full of danger like bears and holes. I had to find the secret treasure at the top.

My brother Max watched me play and kept moaning. "You are going too slow," he said loudly.

I ignored him and kept leading my guy up. My thumbs hurt, but I felt stronger than the boss. I jumped through a ring of fire and won!

"I simply cannot believe you did that," Max said.

I was groaning because my hands were tired. I will write my name on the high score list. Now I am the best player in the house.

We were at recess and it was super hot outside. My friend Billy was climbing up the big slide backwards. He said he simply had to get to the top fast. I told him he was being weird.

"Look at my height!" Billy yelled down at me.

I knew he was going to get in trouble. The teacher blew her whistle really loud. Billy ignored her and kept pumping his legs.

"Get down right now!" the teacher shouted at him.

He stayed up there a little bit longer. Then he found a shiny red rock like a jewel. He slid down and showed me the rock. It was cool but he still got a time-out.

I went camping with my dog Max last week. We often go to the woods near my house. My dad made a big fire and we toasted marshmallows. I touched one but it was too hot! 

Suddenly, a huge moth flew right at my face. "Get away!" I yelled loudly. Max started barking and jumping at the moth. He thought he was a champion hunter. He caught the bug but then he spit it out. 

"Yuck, that tastes bad," I said to Max.

Max made a moaning sound and shook his head. Later, the wind blew hard through the trees. I woke up when a branch fell. It almost crushed our tent! We did not sleep much after that. I did not receive any bug bites though. We didn't see any bears either, which was good.

We drove to the farm on Saturday morning. It took a long time but it was fun. I saw thirteen cows eating green grass. Then we walked to the big red barn. A little white lamb was running around inside. He bounced like a bouncy ball.

"Can I hold him?" I asked the farmer.

"Yes, but you have to be gentle," he said.

I picked up the lamb. He was feeling very soft and warm. I believed he liked me. We watched a duck floating in the pond. We stayed a bit longer to see the pigs. Dad started loading the car with apples. I did not want to leave. But I understood we had to go home. We did not have enough time to play more. I will listen better next time so we can stay longer.

One day I was walking in the woods behind my house. I heard a weird noise near the big oak tree. I looked up and saw my cat Fluffy clinging to a branch! She looked scared and she could not get down. I tried to reach her but she was too high.

"Come down, Fluffy!" I yelled.

"Meow!" she cried back.

I scrambled up the trunk but my shoe caught on the bark. I fell to the ground with a thump. It felt like a failure. But I knew I had to try again. I climbed slower this time and grabbed her paw. She was clinging to my finger. We got down safe enough. My mom came outside and saw us. I was grateful she didn't see me fall. The plain dirt was on my knees though. Fluffy is happy now but she often tries to climb that tree again. Listen to your mom, Fluffy!

My dog Buster looked into the forest and barked loudly. He saw something move behind the big oak tree. I grasped his leash tight and we walked closer. Suddenly a squirrel disappeared up the trunk very fast.

"Come back here!" I screamed at the squirrel.

Buster pulled hard and a vein popped out on my hand. He really wanted to chase it. We stewed there for a minute while Buster grumbled.

"Maybe he went to get nuts," I said.

Then a blue bird sang a happy song above us. It felt like the squirrel’s reign was over. We walked home and Mom brewed us some hot cocoa. I wrote about our big adventure in my journal later.

Me and my best friend Jack went exploring. The weather was rainy but we didn't care. We were playing explorers and roaming near the old science lab. It looked dark and scary.

"I bet there is a monster inside," Jack shouted.

We walked closer and touched the rusty door. Suddenly, we heard a loud sneeze from inside! I was scared and neither of us moved. Then we heard a weird noise like a lamb. We opened the door and saw a tiny white cat. It was just stuck and cold.

"It is not a monster either!" I screamed happily.

We took the cat home. My mom started coaching us on how to feed it. I named him Thirteen because he was lucky.

My friend Sam and I climbed up the big mountain. We wanted to find the secret cave for science class. We neared the top and I saw a dark hole.

"Look at that scary hole!" Sam shouted loudly.

We jumped inside and discovered a huge bear sleeping there. I was trembling so hard. My red sweater got trapped on a sharp rock. Sam pulled me free but he tore it. The tearing sound woke up the bear!

The bear roared and bounced up. It was approaching us fast.

"Run away!" I yelled.

We ran down the path and didn't stop a single time. We were safe at the bottom. We roasted marshmallows later but we did not measure how scared we were. It was a crazy day.

Me and my friend Sam went into the woods. We wanted to find the old castle. People said a king used to reign there. We walked through big trees and tall grass. Suddenly, my heart started thumping really fast. I saw a dark cave. It looked scary though.

"Do you want to go in?" asked Sam.

I grinned and said, "Yes, let's go!"

We grasped our flashlights and walked inside. It was very dark. Then my foot struck something hard. It was a shiny gold box with foreign writing on it! We simply couldn't believe it. We found the treasure! We ran home to show my mom. It was the best adventure ever.

My dog Buster is thirteen years old but he acts young. He is trained to find hidden treasure in the woods. One day we went exploring deep in the forest. We walked for a long time and the light gradually faded. Suddenly Buster stopped and kept bumping my leg with his nose. 

"What is it boy?" I asked him quietly. 

He barked and jumped over a big log. I followed him and saw a dark cave. I was certain something scary was inside. I felt my legs shaking but I stayed steady. Then I saw glowing eyes waiting for us!

"Run back to the house!" I yelled loudly.

We ran fast and didn't stop for fourteen minutes. We were glad for each other's company. We spread the map out later to see where we went. Next time we will bring more friends.

Me and my friend Sam went to the dark woods. We were looking for a lost treasure chest. A cool breeze blew and the leaves moved. We bought a map from an old shop yesterday. Sam was steering us with the map in his hand.

Suddenly a big bear appeared from behind a tree! It was roaming around and looking for food.

"Look at that sign!" I yelled loudly. The sign said DANGER very big and red.

My legs were trembling because I was scared. I realized I had my toy knife in my pocket. The bear was approaching us fast.

"Run back home now!" Sam shouted at me.

We ran all the way home and slept safely. We never found the gold but we were safe.

I sat on the couch with my controller in my hand. My big brother Tom sat next to me and looked super serious. We were playing Space Racers and I was losing bad. My thumbs were stinging from pressing the buttons so fast.

"You are going to get toasted!" Tom yelled at me.

"No way, I wrote down all the secret cheat codes," I said.

I searched my brain for the super boost button. I was yearning for a win because he always wins. Suddenly, my spaceship blew past his red rocket. I chewed on my lip and leaned forward. My ship was hanging in the lead right at the end!

"Hey, you cheated!" he shouted.

I just smiled because I finally treated myself to a victory. I will have to learn even more tricks for next time.

My brother Tim and I went camping in the backyard. We were looking at the stars for my science homework. Suddenly a bright green light crossed the sky. It landed near the big oak tree. I was afraid but Tim ran over there fast. A small robot was dumping purple slime on the grass. The robot looked like a shiny silver toaster with legs.

"Hello earthlings!" the robot beeped loudly.

"Wow, you can talk!" I yelled.

The robot started painting the grass blue with a laser. It was the beginning of a big mess. I was thrilled because I love aliens especially funny ones. We played tag with the robot all night long.

One day my friends and I found a secret map. It showed a hidden island with buried treasure on it. We got a boat and sailed across the surrounding ocean. Suddenly a huge storm struck our small boat hard.

"Hold on tight to the ropes!" I yelled loudly.

My friend Sam grasped the rail and looked scared. We almost fell in but we escaped the big waves. When we got to the beach, sand was scattered everywhere. We walked into the jungle and saw a scary cave.

"I hope we have enough food," Sam grumbled quietly.

We found a gold comb inside an old chest. It was the treasure! We struggled to carry it back to the boat. I was happy nobody got sick with pneumonia from the rain. We learned about psychology at school but this was way better. We were rich!

It was Wednesday and we had science class. Mrs. Green told us to write about volcanoes. Suddenly something happened to my experiment. The red lava brewed inside the plastic cup. I looked at the bubbles jumping up.

"Watch out!" yelled Tommy from the next desk.

The lava escaped the cup and went everywhere. It made a big red stain on my shirt. I felt like a failure because my volcano exploded wrong. Mrs. Green was not stamping her feet though. She smiled and stuck out her tongue.

"That looks like a real messy castle!" she said.

I went to the balcony to dry off in the sun. Science is messy but it is still fun.

Me and my best friend Sam went boating. We were wearing our life jackets and looking for adventure. Sam had an old newspaper that looked like a map.

"The treasure should be right here," spoke Sam loudly.

We landed on a small island and walked straight ahead. We heard a loud noise in the bushes nearby. I drew a picture of a monster in the sand. Suddenly, a big dog bearing a stick came running out! He was just roaming around and wanted to play.

"I think this box will contain gold," I said.

We dug up a small box under a tree. It did not have gold but we did receive cool rocks. We pretended to reign over the island until dinner.

Yesterday was the best day ever. It was raining outside so neither of us could play soccer. My big brother was teaching me a new video game about climbing huge mountains.

"Watch out for the danger!" he yelled at the screen.

I kept pushing the buttons super fast. My character did a bungee jump off a cliff. Then I saw a giant green beetle monster.

"I am the captain now!" I shouted back.

I was beating the monster with my magic sword. I heard a loud boom and I won the level. Especially the hard part at the end. My brother high-fived me. He said I was really good at gaming. We played until dinner and ate pizza.

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods today. We wanted to see the pretty scenery. I gripped his leash tight because he likes squirrels. Suddenly Buster saw a big rabbit and he ran fast! The leash broke and I fell down.

"Oh no, Buster come back!" I yelled very loud.

He did not listen and ran into some bushes. My mom's daughter, my sister, came to help me. We caught Buster but his fur was full of burrs.

"We need scissors to cut this mess," she grumbled.

We walked home and I paid my sister a dollar for helping. Buster was happy but I was muddy. "Next time hold on tighter," my sister said.

I went camping with my dad and my big brother. We walked on a dirt trail for a long time. Dad was teaching us how to set up the tent. We cleared all the rocks and sticks from the ground. Then we made a big fire and ate hot dogs.

"Is there any danger here?" I asked my dad.

"Only if you don't clean up your food," he said.

We put our food in a bag hanging from a tree. Later inside the tent, I heard a loud thumping sound. The wind blew really hard against the tent walls. I was scared, but then I fell asleep. I was dreaming about bears reading a newspaper. In the morning, we did a search for animal tracks. We obtained some cool rocks, and then we went home.

I hate math class because the problems are too hard. My teacher put a new schedule on the wall today. It said recess was next and I felt happy again. I ran outside and saw the big slide.

"Hey, watch this!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

I started climbing up the ladder very fast. But then the wind blew my hat off my head. It flew away and landed in a mud puddle. I pushed past Sam to go get it. The mud made a big brown stain on my new blue hat. I tried to wrap it in a paper towel to dry it.

"That looks really bad," Sam said to me.

I scratched my head and sighed. Then the bell rang and I turned around to go inside. The stain grew bigger and it looked like a funny design now. I guess I need a new hat.

I was sitting in class and my stomach struck me with hunger. It was almost lunchtime but math class felt so long. I looked at the clock and sighed really loud. My teacher Mrs. Miller looked at me and frowned.

"Listen to the lesson please," she said to the class.

Finally the bell rang and I ran to the cafeteria. I obtained my lunchbox from my locker and sat down. My sandwich tasted weird and the bread was chewed up. I think my dog got to it before I left.

"Something is wrong with your food," my friend Tim said.

"I know, it smells like danger," I told him.

I struggled to eat it but I was so hungry. Then I threw it in the trash and touched my apple. I caught a ball at recess later and felt stronger. It was good training for baseball practice after school.

My best friend Ben had pneumonia last month. He was very sick but he is better now. It was his birthday yesterday and I went over. We played on the ground in his backyard.

"Let's climb the mountain!" Ben yelled at me.

The mountain was just a big pile of dirt. I tried to keep my weight steady on it. I did not want to fall through the soft dirt.

"Look out for the fountain!" I yelled back.

His mom has a water fountain near the dirt pile. We almost broke it but she did not know. It was the greatest day ever. Then we caught lightning bugs when it got dark. I saw a sign on his door that said Keep Out. His room was closed but we snuck inside anyway. We pretended to reign over a kingdom of toys. It was hard to contain our laughter.
